steps.en: After the 1st letter, notices needing an electronic reminder are picked
steps.id: Setelah 1st letter, NOPO yang perlu reminder elektronik dipilih
steps.why_en: The reminder job is switched off in every environment and only runs when triggered by hand.
steps.why_id: Job reminder dimatikan di semua environment dan hanya jalan kalau dipicu manual.

steps.en: Latest mobile or email is checked at the data source and saved
steps.id: Mobile atau email terbaru dicek di sumber data lalu disimpan
steps.why_en: The data source lookup is turned off in all environments, so the number typed by the owner is used.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan ke sumber data dimatikan di semua environment, jadi nomor yang diketik owner yang dipakai.

steps.en: Hirers without a valid mobile or email are skipped
steps.id: Hirer tanpa mobile atau email valid dilewati

steps.en: Opted-out or passport hirers get no electronic reminder
steps.id: Hirer opt-out atau ber-passport tidak dikirimi reminder elektronik
